finding.headline: "The Three-Day-No-Shower Mum"
finding.problem: "I haven't washed properly in days. I smell like spit-up and milk. I'm disgusted with myself but the moment I put her down she cries. I cry in the bathroom."
finding.person: 28-yr-old Lagos first-time mum, 5 weeks postpartum, baby Velcro-clings; partner says "just shower, na small thing."
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product → "The 5-Minute Reset Shower Ritual for New Mums"". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
